Du kept the order in his left coat pocket, apart from the note for his clinician. Bai knew which claim she might next be asked to answer and which whole-lift assignment had been rejected. The closed goods lift stayed closed pending its safety process. Lin Yue descended the covered path while rain gathered beneath the court. Behind her, an unanswered line remained visible beside a date and a responsible office, rather than sinking into seventy-five silent days.
